camel_example: aliyun agentcore PUT /workspaces/ws-123456/credentials/cred-123456 --region cn-hangzhou --clientToken '暂不支持' --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body body={credentialMetadata={"apiKey":"sk-example-value"},resourceScope=ALL,description=线上环境调用模型服务使用的_API_Key,resourceRefs=[{resourceId=agent-xxxx,resourceName=my-agent,resourceType=agent}]} --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Updates the content or description of a specified credential. At least one of credentialMetadata and description must be specified. Unspecified properties remain unchanged. The credential name and credential type cannot be modified after creation
description_zh: 更新指定凭证的凭证内容或描述。credentialMetadata 和 description 至少指定一个，未指定的属性保持不变。凭证名称和凭证类型创建后不可修改
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-credential --workspace-id ws-123456 --credential-id cred-123456 --client-token '暂不支持' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCredential

fields.help_en: The new credential content. The value is a JSON string. If credentialType is set to apiKey, only the apiKey field can be included, and the value cannot be empty. At least one of credentialMetadata and description must be specified
fields.help_zh: 新的凭证内容，取值为 JSON 字符串。credentialType 为 apiKey 时只能包含 apiKey 一个字段，且取值不能为空。与 description 至少指定一个
fields.name: credential_metadata

fields.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key
fields.help_en: The new credential description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length. At least one of description and credentialMetadata must be specified
fields.help_zh: 新的凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符。与 credentialMetadata 至少指定一个
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The unique identifier of the resource
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The resource name. This value is empty if the resource has been deleted
fields.help_zh: 资源名称，资源已删除时为空
fields.name: resource_name

fields.help_en: The resource type, such as agent
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: This parameter is required and must be a non-empty array when resourceScope is set to SPECIFIED. Each item contains resourceType and resourceId. resourceName is optional
fields.help_zh: resourceScope 为 SPECIFIED 时必须为非空数组。每项包含 resourceType、resourceId；resourceName 可选
fields.name: resource_refs

fields.help_en: ALL indicates all resources. SPECIFIED indicates that the credential applies only to the resources specified in resourceRefs
fields.help_zh: ALL 表示全部资源；SPECIFIED 表示仅应用到 resourceRefs 指定的资源
fields.name: resource_scope

parameters.help_en: The request body for updating the credential
parameters.name: body

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

credentialMetadata.description_en: The masked credential content. If credentialType is apiKey, the apiKey value is returned as asterisks (*) of equal length
credentialMetadata.description_zh: 凭证内容的脱敏结果。credentialType 为 apiKey 时，apiKey 的取值以等长的 * 返回

credentialType.description_en: The credential type. Currently, only apiKey is supported
credentialType.description_zh: 凭证类型。当前仅支持 apiKey

description.description_en: The credential description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
description.description_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
description.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key

name.description_en: The credential name. The name must be unique within the workspace and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 3 to 128 characters in length and cannot use runtime reserved names
name.description_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~128 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

resourceRefs.description_en: Each item contains resourceType, resourceId, and resourceName. resourceName is empty if the resource has been deleted
resourceRefs.description_zh: 每项包含 resourceType、resourceId、resourceName。资源已删除时 resourceName 为空

resourceId.description_en: The unique identifier of the resource

resourceName.description_en: The resource name. This value is empty if the resource has been deleted
resourceName.description_zh: 资源名称，资源已删除时为空

resourceType.description_en: The resource type, such as agent

resourceRefs.title_en: 凭证可应用的资源列表
resourceRefs.title_zh: 凭证可应用的资源列表

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
